# Google AI Tools (googleaitools.com)

> Independent directory, benchmark evaluations, and architectural reviews of artificial intelligence models, developer APIs, foundation LLMs, and enterprise tools.

Website: https://googleaitools.com
Sitemap: https://googleaitools.com/sitemap.xml
Google News Feed: https://googleaitools.com/news-sitemap.xml
RSS 2.0 Feed: https://googleaitools.com/feed.xml

## Core Directories & Hubs
- [AI Tools Directory](https://googleaitools.com/ai-directory/): 292+ curated AI tools across 11 industry domains (Coding, Video, Audio, Agents, Biotech, Business Automation).
- [Frontier LLMs & Models](https://googleaitools.com/models/): Benchmark specifications, context windows, and throughput metrics for Gemini 4, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4o, DeepSeek-R1, and Llama 3.3.
- [About Editorial Charter](https://googleaitools.com/about/): Independent editorial disclosures and research standards.
- [Contact & Submissions](https://googleaitools.com/contact/): Submitting tool listings and benchmark verification.

## Featured Foundation Models (2026)
- **Gemini 4** (Google DeepMind): 10,000,000 token context window, 195 tok/s, recursive test-time reasoning. Flagship frontier system. [Model Specs](https://googleaitools.com/models/gemini-4/)
- **Gemini 2.5 Pro** (Google): 2,000,000 token context, state-of-the-art STEM reasoning and multi-turn agent coordination. [Model Specs](https://googleaitools.com/models/gemini-2-5-pro/)
- **Claude 3.7 Sonnet** (Anthropic): 200,000 token context, hybrid standard & extended thinking with SWE-bench leadership. [Model Specs](https://googleaitools.com/models/claude-3-7-sonnet/)
- **GPT-4o** (OpenAI): 128,000 token context, omni multimodal audio, vision, and text foundation intelligence. [Model Specs](https://googleaitools.com/models/gpt-4o/)
- **DeepSeek-R1** (DeepSeek): Open-weight large reasoning model trained via large-scale reinforcement learning. [Model Specs](https://googleaitools.com/models/deepseek-r1/)
